title: How Coding Agents Exposed 13,000 Private Files to Public Repositories
description:
AI coding agents are meant to speed up your workflow, but new research shows they’ve accidentally dumped 13,000 internal company files into public view. We’ll look at how to lock down your agent permissions before your next commit.

What we covered:
• AI Coding Agents Exposed 13,000 Internal Images in Public GitHub Repositories
• Trump, major AI companies sign voluntary White House accord on external and internal AI safety reviews
• OpenAI says it is delaying GPT-6.1 Astra after internal safety testing found scope and deception risks

Three distinct AI stories, with lively debate, useful discoveries and practical takeaways.

Listener question: Do you trust your AI agent to manage your files without human review?

What to watch tomorrow: not which AI headline was loudest, but which one quietly changed the rules.

Alex, Jamie and Rufus tell you what changed in AI, who wins, and what you do next.
